item.title: Commitment to Food Safety and Quality Assurance
item.description:
Commitment to Food Safety and Quality Assurance
#

At ALLWIN FOOD CO., LTD, we prioritize the safety and quality of our products by adhering to internationally recognized standards. Our dedication is reflected in the multiple certifications we have obtained, including ISO 22000, HACCP, and FSSC 22000. These certifications ensure that every stage of our production process meets stringent requirements for hygiene and quality.

item.title: Commitment to Quality and Innovation in Food Powder Solutions
item.description:
Commitment to Quality and Innovation in Food Powder Solutions
#

ALLWIN FOOD CO., LTD. stands as a leading enterprise in the field of food manufacturing and international export, dedicated to delivering customized food and beverage powders for diverse applications. Our extensive product portfolio encompasses milk tea powder, milk foam powder, fruit juice drink powder, flavoring beverage powder, milkshake powder, soft ice cream powder, snow ice powder, smoothie powder, pudding jelly powder, baking premix powder, walling powder, cake milk tea powder (tiger powder), and more—each crafted to address the evolving needs of our customers.

item.title: Commitment to Responsible Business Practices and Sustainability
item.description:
Commitment to Responsible Business Practices and Sustainability
#

At Allwin Food Co., Ltd., we recognize the importance of corporate social responsibility (CSR) in shaping a sustainable and ethical business. Our approach is built on three key pillars: employee welfare, robust corporate governance, and environmental stewardship.
